services.name: Processing of Application for lease of market stall or Busines Permit

requirements: 3 pieces of 2×2 colored picture
Community tax certificate
services.where: City public market (EEDMO)

services.name: Clientele / Students who uses Library Materials for Research and Studies
services.summary: Use the city library's books and materials for research and study.
requirements: School ID/Any valid ID’s
services.where: City Library

services.name: Applying for the LGU Subsidized Scholarship Program
services.summary: Apply for a city-funded scholarship for high school or college if your family is poor.
requirements: Bio Data with 2×2 picture
Form 138 or hight school report card
Copy of latest income tax return of the family
Barangay certification that the applicant is a resident of the barangay and that he/she is of good moral character
All photocopies must be authenticated
services.where: City Human Resource Management Office (HRMO)

services.name: Issuance of Business Permit and Licenses
services.summary: Get a new or renewed permit to run a business in Lamitan City.
requirements: Residence certificate
Barangay clearance
Police clearance
Court clearance
Application to lease for market stalls (for market occupants)
Medical cerificate
Sanitary permits
Zoning clearance
Old Business Permit for renewal
4 pcs 2×2 picture of the owner/Manager

services.name: Availing of Public Customer Assistance
services.summary: Get a referral or endorsement letter for medical aid, a job, or a government transfer.
requirements: For Medical Assistance: Medical prescriptions
For Medical Assistance: Clinical diagnosis or doctor’s referral
For Job Recommendation: Complete bio-data or curriculum vitae
For Job Recommendation: Police clearance
For Job Recommendation: Past employment records
For Job Recommendation: Other related documents
For Endorsement for Transfer: Letter request for transfer
For Endorsement for Transfer: Letter of request for transfer stating therein reasons for request
For Endorsement for Transfer: Certified service record, if available
services.where: Office of the City Mayor

services.name: Zoning Clearance Application
services.summary: Get zoning or locational clearance for a business, building, or land subdivision.
requirements: For Temporary Use Permit: Certification (business permit)
For Temporary Use Permit: Location Clearance
For Temporary Use Permit: Decision on Zoning
For Building Permit: Plan with site development/location
For Building Permit: Cost of estimates and bill of materials
For Building Permit: Location Clearance
For Building Permit: Transfer Certificate of Title (Latest)
For Building Permit: Tax Receipt/Tax Clearance (Latest)
For Building Permit: Decision of Zoning
For Building Permit: Certification
For Building Permit: Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC)
For Building Permit: Pollution Control Certificate (DENR)
For Subdivision: Application for subdivision form
For Subdivision: Application for Development Permit Form
For Subdivision: Application for preliminary approval form
For Subdivision: Subdivision Approval Form
For Subdivision: Transfer Certificate of Title (Latest)
For Subdivision: Tax Declaration (Latest)
For Subdivision: Tax Receipt/Tax Clearance (Latest)
For Subdivision: Subdivision Plan with Vicinity Map (duly signed by the Geodetic Engineer)
For Subdivision: Location Clearance
For Subdivision: Certification
services.fee: Temporary use permit: zoning certification fee P100.00, locational clearance P200.00. Building permit: zoning certification, location clearance and land use and zoning fees 1.00; coe x 0.01%; 200.00. Subdivision: subdivision fee P100, development permit P200, preliminary approval zoning certification fee P220
services.where: City Planning and Development Office (CPDO), Zoning; fees paid at the City Treasury Office

services.name: Requesting the Preparation of Plans and Programs of Work
services.summary: Ask city engineers to prepare plans, estimates and programs of work for roads, drainage or buildings.
services.where: City Engineer’s Office (Construction and Maintenance Division)

services.name: Processing of Building Permit
services.summary: Get a building permit approved before constructing a building.
requirements: If applicant is the Registered Owner of the Lot: Certified true copy of TCT and approved lot plan duly signed by the Geodetic Engineer (3 copies each)
Tax Declaration (3 photo copies each)
Current Real Property Tax Receipt (3 photo copies each)

Six (6) sets of plans (blue print) signed and sealed by duly licensed Architect or Civil Engineer professional, Electrical Engineer, Sanitary/Plumbing Engineer, Mechanical Engineer and Owner of Applicant
Six (6) sets of estimates/Bill of Materials signed and sealed by a duly licensed Architect or Civil Engineer Owner
Structural analysis/soil bearing capacity duly signed by structural Engineer and owner
Barangay Clearance for securing Building Permit Forms signed by Civil Engineer and Owner/Applicant
ECC-Environment Compliace Certificates (from DENR)
If Applicant is not Registered Owner of the Lot (3 Photo copies each): Duly notarized copy of the contract of least, or
Duly notarized copy of the deed of Sale
services.where: Office of the Building Official (City Engineer’s Office)

services.name: Cancellation, Revision or Correction of Assessments
services.summary: Have the assessment on your real property cancelled, revised or corrected.
requirements: Letter of request for cancellation, correction or revision of assessment
Tax Clearance Certificate
services.where: City Assessor’s Office

services.name: Securing Assessment for a new building or machinery and real properties declared for the first time
services.summary: Get a new tax declaration for a new building, machinery or first-time declared property.
requirements: Letter of request/Personal request
Building permit/floor plan
Certificate of Occupancy
Receipts of machinery acquisition
services.where: City Assessor’s Office

services.name: Securing certified true copy of tax declarations, landholding or no improvements
services.summary: Get a certified copy of a tax declaration or a landholding or no-improvement certification.
requirements: Photocopy of Tax Declaration/Personal Request
Request Slip of the BIR/Register of Deeds
Certification fee of P50.00 per request
services.where: City Assessor’s Office

services.name: Annotating or cancelling bail bonds on tax declaration’s & verifying status of real property tax assessment on tax map
services.summary: Get a bail bond annotated or cancelled on a tax declaration, or find property on the tax map.
requirements: Trial court order for annotation/cancellation
Photocopy of Title or Tax Declaration
services.where: City Assessor’s Office (Records and Tax Mapping)

services.name: Securing Mayor’s Clearance
services.summary: Get a mayor's clearance for a firearms license or job application.
requirements: Original copy if police clearance
original copy of barangay clearance
Latest community tax certificate
Official Receipts (from the City Treasurer’s Office)
1 set of doc. Stamp
Photocopies of the Barangay clearance and police clearance
services.where: Office of the City Mayor

services.name: Front line Services: Delivery of basic social services
services.summary: Get social welfare help for children, youth, women, elderly, disabled people, disaster victims and families.
requirements: Form 200
Barangay Certificate
Certified Through Copy
Certification of Eligibility
Birth Certificate/Marriage Contract
Family Data Survey Form
services.where: City Social Welfare and Development Office

services.name: Registration of Birth, Marriage, Death Correction of entries under R.A. 9048
services.summary: Register a birth, marriage or death, correct civil registry entries, or get certified copies.
requirements: Birth (Current): marriage contract of parents and attachments for non-christian
Delayed Registration of Birth, 1 month to 17 years old: Marriage contract of parents, baptismal certificate, affidavit of birth with two witnesses, school records form 137, barangay certification

Delayed Registration of Birth, 18 yrs old and above: CRS Form No.1 (Negative Certification of Birth at NSO Regional Office Zamboanga City), Xerox Copy of any valid ID’s, Service Records, 1 copy of 2×2 picture, other requirements mentioned above
Death: For vehicular or shooting accident, spot report from the police authority, Barangay certification
Delayed registration of death: Affidavit of delayed registration of death by any of the nearest relative of the deceased or by any person having legal charge of the deceased when he was still alive
Marriage: Certification of No Marriage records (CENOMAR), live birth certificate of both contracting parties, pre-cana seminar, POPCOM Seminar, permission to marry for AFP personnel only
Marriage under article 34: Joint affidavit with years union as husband and wife with no legal impediments

Delayed Registration of Marriage: Copy of Marriage Certificate to be registered, affidavit executed by the registrant surrounding the marriage and the reason of the cause of the delayed, certification from the church

Out of Town registration: The same requirement as delayed registration of birth with additional of affidavit of out of town, registration attested with two witness, money order address to civil registrar where it is forwarded for processing fee and other incidental expenses

Annotated civil registry documents affected by R.A. 9048: City/Municipal Registrar and Civil Registrar General approved petition, certificate, certificate of finality, annotated certificate, original (un-annotated) certificate
Certificate true copy/Form 1a/Authentication: Processing Fee, Documentary stamp
services.fee: Birth P80.00; Death P80.00; Marriage License P100.00; Certified True Copy P80.00; Attachment P40.00; Authentication P30.00; Legitimation P70.00
services.where: Office of the City Civil Registrar

requirements: Letter request and details needed for the Article

services.name: Request for Information Dissemination via 2-Way Radio

requirements: Letter request and details needed for the Article
services.where: Provincial Information Office

services.name: Assistance to Visitor/Transactor
services.summary: Get a visitor's tag and entry to the Provincial Capitol after signing the logbook.
requirements: Present I.D. (sign in the visitor's log book at the entrance gate of the Capitol)

services.name: Assistance to Parking or Traffic Arrangement inside @ Outskirt of Capitol (i.e. Vehicular Incident inside A.O.R.)
services.summary: Get help with parking, traffic or a vehicle incident at the Capitol, including mediation and settlement.
requirements: I.D. card
Disclose facts
services.where: Provincial Security Force Office

services.name: Assistance to Owner of Lost and Found Article(s)

Details of lost and/or found article

services.name: Security Assistance to the Handling of Amicable Settlement (Rido-Family Feud) and Social Activities/Programs
services.summary: Get security guards assigned to a rido settlement or a social activity.
requirements: Letter request or referral from P-Governor's Office
services.where: Provincial Security Force Office

services.name: Complaint for Theft, Robbery and Other Unlawful Acts Committed inside the AOR (Capitol)
services.summary: File a complaint about theft or other crimes at the Capitol and have it investigated.
requirements: Valid I.D.
Details of event
services.where: Provincial Security Force Office

services.name: Provision/Release of Socio-Economic Data, Development Plans, Maps and Other Documents
services.summary: Get copies of the province's socio-economic data, development plans and maps.
requirements: Request Letter from the agency head stating the data requested addressed to the Provincial Planning and Development Coordinator
Fill up request form and present valid ID for walk-in client
Blank CD/DVD, USB

services.name: Project Proposal Preparation
services.summary: Have the planning office prepare a project proposal for your agency.
requirements: Letter request from the agency head stating the project proposal addressed to the PPDC
services.where: Provincial Planning and Development Office

services.name: Financial Assistance for RA 9208/9262 Victims
services.summary: Victims of trafficking or violence against women and children get a cash assistance check.
requirements: Medical Certificate
Case Study Report of MSWDO and PSWDO
Certificate of Eligibility of MSWDO/PSWDO
Police Blotter
services.where: Provincial Planning and Development Office

services.name: Technical Assistance
services.summary: Get field visits and farming or fisheries advice from provincial agriculture technicians.
requirements: Project Proposal / Letter Request

services.name: Financial Assistance

requirements: Project Proposal / Letter Request / Resolution / Application Form
services.where: Office of the Provincial Agriculturist

services.name: Medical Check-Up / Consultation
services.summary: See a provincial doctor for a check-up, diagnosis and prescribed medicines.
services.where: Provincial Health Office

services.name: Dental Services
services.summary: Get a dental examination and treatment from the provincial dentist.
services.where: Provincial Health Office

services.name: Prenatal Check-Up
services.summary: Pregnant women get a prenatal examination, health advice and prenatal medicines.
services.where: Provincial Health Office

services.name: Medical Certificates
services.summary: Get a medical certificate after a physical examination by the physician on duty.
services.where: Provincial Health Office

services.name: Issuance of Permits (Quarry, Sand and Gravel, Pebble-Picking, Guano, Gemstone-Gathering)
services.summary: Get a provincial permit to quarry, extract sand and gravel, or gather guano, pebbles or gemstones.
requirements: Application Form
Clearance from the government agencies concerned that may be affected by the proposed project, or written permission from the land owner(s) and surface owner(s) of the area applied
Survey plan of the area for extraction (Five blueprint copies and the original tracing plan of the area applied for duly signed and sealed by a Licensed Geodetic Engineer)
Certified copy of Articles of Incorporation/Partnership/Association and By-Laws, if applicable, to be registered with PENRO
Duly notarized Special Power of Attorney if application is filed by an agent or representative to be registered with PENRO
Audited Financial Statement for Corporation/Partnership or Income Tax Return immediately preceding three (3) years for individuals, or credit lines
Area Clearance (from MGB - Regional Office)
Certificate Environmental Management and Community Relations Record (CEMCRR) (from MGB - Regional Office)
Certificate of Lodging (from MRFC)
Work Program
Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) (EMB Region)
Excise Tax Certificate (from the BIR) (for renewal of permits only)
Certificate of Posting (from the concerned LGU's)
Project Proposal (for Government Gratuitous Permit Application)
Surety Bond except for Gratuitous and Exclusive Sand & Gravel
Permit
Verification Report (from PENRO)
Other supporting papers as the concerned Regional Office/Provincial Mining Regulatory Board may require for the applicant may submit
services.where: Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office

services.name: Issuance of Transport Permit and Mineral Export Permit
services.summary: Get a permit to transport minerals out of the province or export them abroad.
requirements: Application Form (from PENRO - MGDS) (2 copies)
Photocopy (4 sets) of Mining/Quarry Permit
Photocopy (4 sets) of Mineral products Purchase Order
Photocopy (4 sets) of Delivery Receipt
Photocopy (4 sets) of Sales Invoice
Photocopy (4 sets) of BIR Official Receipt for Excise Tax payment for Mineral Products
Photocopy (4 sets) of Registered Special Power of Attorney (if filed by a representative of the applicant)
services.where: Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (MGDS)

services.name: Request for the Use of Gov't. Equipments and Facilities/Renting Out of Facilities
services.summary: Borrow or rent provincial facilities and equipment such as tables and chairs.
requirements: Letter request/verbal
Fully accomplished reservation borrower's slip form
Official Receipt of payment
services.fee: Rental fee (see attached rental fees on official receipt)
services.where: Provincial General Services Office (Admin Division)

services.name: Payment of Real Property Tax
services.summary: Pay your yearly real property tax and get an official receipt.
requirements: Official Receipt (Last Payment)
Statement of Accounts
Tax Declaration
services.fee: Basic (1% of the Assessed Value); SEF (1% of the Assessed Value)
services.where: Provincial Treasurer's Office (Revenue Operations Division)

services.name: Payment of Transfer Tax
services.summary: Pay the transfer tax when property ownership changes hands.
requirements: Latest Tax Declaration
Notarized Documents
Official Receipt of Last Payment
services.fee: 50% of 1% of the Market Value or amount of sale whichever is higher; 25% Surcharge, 2% interest/mo. not to exceed 72% (after 2 mos. grace period)
services.where: Provincial Treasurer's Office (Revenue Operations Division)

services.name: Payment of Professional Tax
services.summary: Licensed professionals pay their yearly professional tax and get an official receipt.
requirements: Updated/Renewed PRC License
In the absence of PRC ID, Proof of Payment
services.fee: Bracket A: P500.00 (doctors, dentists, lawyers, architects, CPAs, engineers and similar); Bracket B: P400.00 (nurses, midwives and all other professions)
services.where: Provincial Treasurer's Office (Revenue Operations Division)

services.name: Payment of Franchise Tax
services.summary: Businesses with a franchise pay the provincial franchise tax.
requirements: Audited Financial Report of the previous year
Annual Gross Receipts of the previous year
Statement of Cash Receipts
services.where: Provincial Treasurer's Office (Revenue Operations Division)

services.name: Payment of Sand & Gravel, Guano, Quarry and Other Mineral Resources
services.summary: Pay the permit fees and taxes for quarrying and mineral extraction.
requirements: Complete and approved documents from concerned agencies
services.fee: Varies by kind of permit (e.g. Private Gratuitous P580; Government Gratuitous P460+; Pebble-Picking P1,680+; Industrial P9,550.00); see fee tables
services.where: Provincial Treasurer's Office (Revenue Operations Division)

services.name: Payment of Annual Fixed Tax on Delivery Trucks and Vans
services.summary: Pay the yearly fixed tax on your delivery trucks, vans and motorcycles.
requirements: Previous O.R.
services.fee: Large Truck Php 500.00; Medium Trucks Php 300.00; Small Vans & Jeeps Php 200.00; Motorized Cycle Php 50.00; Annual Permit Fee Php 200.00; Sticker Fee Php 50.00
services.where: Provincial Treasurer's Office (Revenue Operations Division)

charter.label: Provincial Government of Maguindanao del Sur, Citizen Charter 2023, 3rd Edition

services.name: Budget Review
services.summary: The province reviews and helps finish your town's annual or supplemental budget.
requirements: Annual Performance Budget (Municipal) (MLGU)
Supplemental Budget (MLGU)
Ordinance (MLGU)
services.where: PBO-Assistor and Review Division

services.name: Provision of Emergency Medical Care and Transport
services.summary: Call the hotline and a rescue team gives first aid and takes the patient to hospital.
services.where: PDRRMO-Operations and Warning Division

services.name: Provision of Standby Medic and Firetruck
services.summary: Ask for a medic team and fire truck to stand by at your event.
requirements: Letter Request (Client)
services.where: PDRRMO-Operations and Warning Division

services.name: Provision of Technical Assistance to Conduct Training on Disaster Risk Reduction and Management (DRRM)
services.summary: Ask the province to train your group in disaster preparedness, first aid and basic life support.
requirements: Letter Request (Client)
services.where: PDRRMO-Administration and Training Division

services.name: Provision of Food and Non-Food Items to Victims of Calamities or Other Disaster-Related Incidents
services.summary: Families hit by fighting, fire, floods or other disasters get food, relief goods and family kits.
requirements: Letter Request (Client)
services.where: PDRRMO-Operations and Warning Division

services.name: Lease of Heavy Equipments
services.summary: Rent the province's excavators, dump trucks, graders, cranes or buses for your project.
requirements: Request Letter Address to the Governor (Requesting Party/LGU)
Original Receipt (Provincial Treasurer’s Office)
services.fee: ₱6,000.00 to ₱19,320.00 depending on the equipment; see the schedule of fees
services.where: Provincial Engineer’s Office

services.name: Recruitment, Selection and Placement
services.summary: Apply for an open job at the provincial government and go through screening and exams.
requirements: Application Letter (Interested Applicant)
Fully Accomplished Personal Data Sheet (PDS) (CSC Form 212, Revised 2017) (Interested Applicant)
Performance Rating for the last two (2) rating periods if applicable (for promotion and transfer) (Interested Applicant)
Photocopy of Certificate of Eligibility/rating/license (Interested Applicant)
Photocopy of Transcript of Records (Interested Applicant)
services.where: Recruitment, Selection and Placement Division

services.name: Inspection Collection of Real Property Tax (Basic & SEF)
services.summary: Pay the yearly tax on your land, building or machinery and get a tax clearance.
requirements: Latest Official Receipt of last Payment or Certificate of Payment/ Original Copy or Certified True Copy of Real Property Tax Declaration/ Original or Certified True Copy of Tax Clearance (Client’s Copy/ Local Assessor)
services.fee: 1% basic tax and 1% SEF tax on the assessed value; ₱150.00 for a tax clearance
services.where: PTO- Revenue Division

services.name: Collection of Transfer Tax
services.summary: Pay the tax due when land or property is sold, donated or otherwise transferred.
requirements: Deed of Sale, donation or any applicable document proving transfer of ownership/ Original Copy of Real Property Tax Declaration/ Tax Clearance or updated tax payment (Official Receipt) (Client’s Copy/ Local Assessor)
services.fee: 60% of 1% of the market value or cost of sale/donation, whichever is higher
services.where: PTO- Revenue Division

services.name: Collection of Professional Tax
services.summary: Licensed professionals pay their yearly professional tax and get an official receipt.
requirements: Current annual registration card or PRC License (Client’s Copy)
services.where: PTO-Revenue Division

services.name: Collection of Franchise Tax
services.summary: Businesses holding a franchise pay their yearly franchise tax to the province.
requirements: Financial Statement of the preceding year / Gross sales receipts (Client’s Copy)
services.fee: 60% of 1% of the gross annual receipts of the preceding year
services.where: PTO-Revenue Division

services.name: Collection of Annual Fixed Tax on Delivery Truck & Vans and Issuance of Governor’s Permit and Sticker
services.summary: Businesses pay the yearly tax on delivery trucks and vans and get a Governor's Permit and sticker.
requirements: OR/CR to ensure that the vehicle used is registered (Client’s Copy)
services.where: PTO-Revenue Division

services.name: Collection of Tax on Sand and Gravel and Issuance of Governor’s Permit
services.summary: Quarry operators pay the tax on sand, gravel and other materials and get a Governor's Permit.
requirements: Documents from PMRC (Client’s Copy)
Delivery Receipt (Duplicate Copy) (Provincial’s Copy)
services.fee: See the schedule of fees (permit fees ₱200.00 to ₱2,500.00; tax of ₱50.00/cu.m for sand and gravel, ₱20.00/cu.m for limestone)
services.where: PTO-Revenue Division

services.name: Collection of Other Fees and Charges
services.summary: Pay fees for certifications, authentications, veterinary health certificates and loan documents.
requirements: Transaction Slip (Office Concerned)
services.fee: ₱100.00 each for certification, authentication, veterinary health certificate or loan documents
services.where: PTO-Revenue Division

services.name: Request for Tourism-Related Inquiries and Initiatives
services.summary: Bring your tourism question, plan or proposal to the province for review and support.
requirements: Proposals, Plans, Datasheets, and other pertinent documents (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office/Planning and Development

services.name: Request for Tourist Attraction Assessment
services.summary: Ask the province to assess a place as a tourist attraction.
requirements: Proposals, Plans, Datasheets, and other pertinent documents (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office/Planning and Development

services.name: Technical Assistance
services.summary: Town tourism and planning officers get help with tourism statistics, training and marketing.
requirements: Request form (Requesting Party/LGU)
Information needed
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office/Planning and Development

services.name: Request for Tourism Information Assistance Center (TIAC) Visit
services.summary: Visit the tourism center and museum for a guided tour and travel information.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office/Marketing and Promotion

services.name: Financial Assistance Services/Festival Celebration
services.summary: Towns get financial help from the province for their festivals and anniversaries.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/LGU)
Recommendation of the grant of financial assistance (Provincial Tourism Office)
Approved Letter Request (Provincial Governor’s Office)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office/Marketing and Promotion

services.name: Request for Performing Arts Ensemble
services.summary: Book the province's music and dance performers for your event.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office

services.name: Accommodate Inquiries on Tourism/Cultural Activities of the Province
services.summary: Ask about and get the schedule of the province's tourism and cultural activities.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office

services.name: Request for Tour Guiding Services to Historical Places in the Province
services.summary: Get a guided tour of historical places in the province.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: Provincial Tourism Office

services.name: Aid to Person with Disability
services.summary: Persons with disability living in the province get help with assistive devices.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
Referral Letter (MSWDO/Barangay)
services.where: Persons with Disability Affairs Office

services.name: Request for Development Plan
services.summary: Get a copy of the province's development plans, such as the PDPFP or PCIP.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
services.where: OPPDC / Plans and Program Division

services.name: Request for Various Maps, Data and Shape Files
services.summary: Get maps, data and GIS shape files of the province for planning.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
services.where: OPPDC / Plans and Program Division

services.name: Review of Annual MLGU GAD Plan and Budget
services.summary: The province reviews and endorses your town's yearly Gender and Development plan and budget.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/MLGU)
services.where: OPPDC / Plans and Program Division

services.name: Provision of Technical Services on the Development Plans and Maps (Plans and Program Division)
services.summary: Planners and mappers from the province help you prepare development plans and maps.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
services.where: OPPDC / Plans and Program Division

services.name: Request for Statistical Data/Information
services.summary: Get copies of the province's statistics and planning data.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
services.where: OPPDC / Project Monitoring Information Division

services.name: Provision of Technical Services on the Development Plans and Maps (Project Monitoring Information Division)
services.summary: Get help preparing an ecological profile, accomplishment reports and other town promotional materials.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
services.where: OPPDC / Project Monitoring Information Division

services.name: Extension Services/Technical Assistance
services.summary: Farmers get expert advice, training and on-farm help with crops and farm problems.
requirements: Request Letter (From Clientele/ Farmer)
services.where: Office of the Provincial Agriculturist

services.name: Distribution of Agricultural Inputs, Planting Materials and Livelihood Projects
services.summary: Farmers receive seedlings, farm inputs and livelihood projects after a site check.
requirements: Request Letter (From Clientele/ Farmer)
services.where: Office of the Provincial Agriculturist

services.name: Nutrition Services
services.summary: Get nutrition counseling and nutrition program activities for your community.
requirements: Request Letter (From Clientele/ Farmer)
services.where: Office of the Provincial Agriculturist

services.name: Issuance of Veterinary Health Certificate (Livestock Traders: Cattle, Carabao, Swine and Horse)
services.summary: Livestock traders get the health certificate needed to transport cattle, carabao, pigs or horses.
requirements: Certificate of ownership of poultry/ livestock animals (Municipal Licensing Office)
Certificate of transfer of ownership of large animals (Municipal Licensing Office)
Mayor’s business permit (Municipal Licensing Office)
Livestock handler’s permit (DA region XII)
Police clearance (Police Office)
Result of blood samples for (ASF, Surra, EIA) (RADDL)
Shipping Permit (Quarantine Office)
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Issuance of Veterinary Health Certificate for Transport (Poultry, Duck Farmers and Game Fowl Enthusiasts)
services.summary: Poultry and duck raisers and gamefowl owners get the health certificate needed to transport their birds.
requirements: Mayor’s/Business Permit (Municipal Licensing Office)
Livestock Handler’s Permit (Municipal Licensing Office)
Result of Blood Samples (Avian Influenza) (RADDL)
NCD Vaccination Card (Veterinarian/Livestock Technician)
Shipping Permit (Quarantine Office)
services.where: OPVET-Regulatory Division

services.name: Issuance of Veterinary Health Certificate for Transport of Pet Animals
services.summary: Pet owners get the health certificate needed to travel with or ship their pets.
requirements: Pet Animal Vaccination Card (Veterinary)
Official Receipt (Provincial Treasury Office)
services.where: OPVET-Regulatory Division

services.name: Issuance of Veterinary Health Certificate (Livestock and Poultry Farmers, Duck, Quail, Chicken Eggs and Balut)
services.summary: Farmers get the health certificate needed to transport animals, eggs and balut.
requirements: Result of blood samples (Avian Influenza) (RDDL)
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Animal Health Services (Walk In/House to House/Barangay)
services.summary: Livestock and poultry farmers get their animals checked and treated by a veterinarian.
requirements: Client presence
Animals
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Routine Services/Vitamins/Deworming and Iron Administration (Walk In/House to House/Barangay)
services.summary: Farm animals get vitamins, deworming and iron shots to keep them healthy.
requirements: Client presence
Data of animals
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Anti-Rabies (Walk-In)
services.summary: Bring your dog or cat for a free anti-rabies shot and vaccination card.
requirements: Client presence
Vaccination Card (Provincial Veterinarian/Veterinarian II)
Pet Animal
services.where: OPVET-Regulatory and Control Division

services.name: Anti-Rabies (House to House/Barangay)
services.summary: Vets visit your barangay to give free anti-rabies shots to pets.
requirements: Request letter (Municipal Hall/Barangay Hall)
Pet animal
services.where: OPVET-Regulatory and Control Division

services.name: Animal Disease Surveillance (Blood Collection of Animals)
services.summary: Get blood and other samples from your animals tested for diseases like African swine fever.
requirements: Client presence
Letter request
Transport media (Regional Animal Disease Diagnostic Laboratory (RADDL))
Animals
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Animal Welfare Services/Castration/Spaying/Minor Surgeries for Dogs and Cats (Walk-In)
services.summary: Get your dog or cat spayed, castrated or given minor surgery for free.
requirements: Client presence
Pet animals
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Veterinary Quarantine Services
services.summary: Vehicles carrying animals or meat are checked and disinfected to keep diseases like ASF out.
requirements: Veterinary Health Certificate (Veterinary Office)
FDA Certificate (FDA)
DTI Certificate (DTI)
NMIS (NMIS)
Shipping Permit (Veterinary Quarantine Office)
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Artificial Insemination/Carabao/Cattle and Goat (Barangay)
services.summary: Technicians visit your barangay to artificially inseminate carabao, cattle and goats for better breeds.
requirements: Request Letter
services.where: OPVET-Livestock and Poultry Division

services.name: Request for Issuance of New Tax Declaration
services.summary: Get a new tax declaration after buying property or adding a building or machinery.
requirements: Present Photocopy of title/TD or real property tax receipt and other reference of property identification for assessment and appraisal (Requesting Party (CLIENTS))
Additional requirements for authorized representative requesting
Owner’s authorization letter/SPA
Photocopy of Valid ID
services.where: PASSO-Evaluation & Assessment Division

services.name: Annotation of Mortgages/Bail Bond/Liens or Its Cancellation to the Field Appraisal and Assessment Sheet (FAAS) and Tax Declaration (TD)
services.summary: Have a mortgage, bail bond or lien, or its cancellation, recorded on your property's tax declaration.
requirements: Copy mortgage/bail bond /lien documents or its cancellation documents (Mortgage- banks, credit unions, mortgage lenders, mortgage, brokers, and other mortgage companies)
services.where: Provincial Assessor’s Office

services.name: Legislative Services
services.summary: Towns get certified copies of resolutions and ordinances passed by the provincial board.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party/LGU)
services.where: OSSP

services.name: Accreditation of CSO
services.summary: Civil society groups and NGOs apply to be accredited by the provincial board.
requirements: Letter of Application signifying intention for accreditation, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Duly accomplished application form for accreditation, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Board resolution signifying intention for accreditation, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Certificate of Registration, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
List of current officers and members, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Original Sworn Statement, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Annual accomplishment report, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Financial Statement, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Copy of the minutes of the latest meeting of the organization, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
Profile indicating purpose and objective of the organization, 15 copies (Requesting Party)
services.where: OVG, SP and OSSP

services.name: Provision of Legal Technical Assistance
services.summary: Mayors, barangay officials and provincial officials get legal opinions on contracts, ordinances and agreements.
services.where: Office of the Provincial Legal

services.name: Legal Advise and Other Legal Services
services.summary: Walk in and get free legal advice from the Provincial Legal Officer.
services.where: Office of the Provincial Legal

services.name: Administering Oath and Preparation of Affidavits
services.summary: Have an affidavit or other legal document prepared and sworn for free.
requirements: Valid ID
CTC
services.where: Office of the Provincial Legal

services.name: Hospitalization Assistance to Senior Citizens
services.summary: Senior citizens living in the province get help paying hospital bills or a referral letter.
requirements: Hospital Bill (Hospital)
Clinical Abstract; or Medical Certificate
services.where: Provincial Governor’s Office-Office for Senior Citizens Affairs

services.name: Provide Assistive Device to Senior Citizens
services.summary: Senior citizens living in the province get canes, crutches, walkers or wheelchairs.
requirements: Request Letter (Requesting Party)
services.where: Provincial Governor’s Office-Office for Senior Citizens Affairs

services.name: Food/Financial/Transportation Assistance
services.summary: Food, cash or transport help for people facing a sudden money crisis.
requirements: Valid ID (Xerox) (Clients Personal Documents)
Barangay Certification (Xerox) (Barangay Hall/Barangay Official)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Issuance of Certification (Proof of Indigence)
services.summary: A certificate proving you are a low-income earner.
requirements: Barangay Certification (Xerox) (Barangay Hall/Barangay Official)
BIR Certification (Xerox) if needed (BIR Staff)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Social Case Study Report
services.summary: A social worker's report you need to apply for medical or hospital aid.
requirements: Valid ID (Xerox) (Personal Documents of Clients)
Barangay Certification (Xerox) (Barangay Hall/Barangay Official)
Medical Abstract (Xerox) (Hospital Staffs)
Final Billing (Xerox) (Hospital Staffs)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Medical Assistance (Crisis Intervention)
services.summary: Help paying for medicines through a partner pharmacy when you cannot afford them.
requirements: Valid ID (Xerox) (Personal Documents of Clients)
Barangay Certification (Xerox) (Barangay Hall/Barangay Official)
Medical Abstract (Xerox) (Hospital Staffs)
Final Billing (Xerox) (Pharmacy)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Medical Assistance and Hospital Assistance (Senate Funds MOA)
services.summary: A referral letter to the Malasakit Center at Cotabato Regional Medical Center for hospital bill help.
requirements: Valid ID (Xerox) (Personal Documents of Clients)
Medical Certificate (Xerox) (Hospital Staffs)
Final Billing (Xerox) (Hospital Staffs)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Emergency PhilHealth (PHIC) Card
services.summary: Emergency PhilHealth coverage when you are suddenly hospitalised and cannot pay.
requirements: Valid ID (Xerox) (Personal Documents of Clients)
Barangay Certificate (Xerox) (Barangay Official/Barangay Hall)
Certificate of Confinement (Xerox) (Hospital Staffs)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Relief Operation (Natural and Man-Made Calamities)
services.summary: Food and non-food relief packs for victims of disasters and other calamities.
requirements: Assessment and Validation Report that they are Victims of Natural and Man-Made Calamities from Barangay Officials and CIDRO Staffs (Barangay Officials and CIDRO Staff)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Crisis Intervention and Disaster Relief Operation (CIDRO) Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Custodial Issue Mediation/Settlement Process)
services.summary: Help settling a child custody dispute through a case conference with your barangay.
requirements: Birth Certificate (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Marriage Certificate (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Other Documents (depends on circumstances)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Children-At-Risk – CNSP)
services.summary: Protection, medico-legal help, counselling and case filing for children who suffered abuse.
requirements: Communication Letter (optional for walk-in client) (Respective Barangay/BCPC/Agency)
Barangay Blotter/Police Blotter/ Spot Report (Respective Barangay/Police Station)
Certificate of Live Birth (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Result of Medical Examination/ Medico-legal (If possible) (CRMC Hospital)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Children-At-Risk – Violators)
services.summary: Temporary shelter, values formation and case conferences for children who break ordinances or commit light offences.
requirements: Communication Letter (Respective Barangay/BCPC/Agency)
Barangay Certificate (Respective Barangay/BCPC)
Certificate of Live Birth (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
School ID/ School Records (If possible) (Respective School)
Result of Medical Examination/ Medico-legal (CRMC Hospital)
Barangay Blotter/Police Blotter/ Spot Report (Respective Barangay/Police Station)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Children In-Conflict with the Law (CICL)/Children Deprived of Liberty)
services.summary: Social worker help, release requests and diversion programs for children accused of a crime.
requirements: Communication Letter (optional for walk-in client) (Respective Barangay/BCPC/Agency)
Barangay Certificate (Respective Barangay/BCPC)
Certificate of Live Birth (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
School ID/ School Records (If possible) (Respective School)
Result of Medical Examination/ Medico-legal (If possible) (CRMC Hospital)
Barangay Blotter/Police Blotter/ Spot Report (Respective Barangay/Police Station)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Request for Certification of Custody)
services.summary: A certificate of custody a child needs to claim a survivorship pension.
requirements: Barangay Certificate (for minor) (Respective Barangay)
Certificate of Live Birth of minor (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Certificate of Marriage of Parents (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Death Certificate of Deceased Parent(s) (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Other Documents (depends on circumstances)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Request for Certification for Passport Application)
services.summary: A social welfare certificate a child needs to apply for a passport.
requirements: Barangay Certificate (for minor) (Respective Barangay)
Certificate of Live Birth of minor (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Parent(s) Consent/ Authorization Letter (Parent(s) of the minor)
Two (2) valid I.D. of the Parent(s) (Any Government Agency)
Two (2) valid I.D. of the Applicant (If not the parents) (Any Government Agency)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Child Welfare Program - Protective Services (Application for Travel Clearance)
services.summary: A travel clearance for a child travelling alone or without parents within the Philippines.
requirements: Barangay Certificate (for minor) (Respective Barangay)
Certificate of Live Birth of minor (Philippine Statistic Authority (PSA))
Airline Ticket of the minor & adult companion (Airline ticketing office)
Parent(s) Consent/ Authorization Letter (Parent(s) of the minor)
Two (2) valid I.D. of the Parent(s) (Any Government Agency)
Two (2) valid I.D. of the minor companion/applicant (Any Government Agency)
Accomplished travel clearance form (OSWDS)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Child Welfare Section

services.name: Solo Parent Identification (ID) Issuance
services.summary: A solo parent ID card for single parents raising children alone.
requirements: Barangay Certification of Residency (Barangay Hall)
Proof of evidence being solo parent (death certificate, separation papers, affidavit of being Solo Parent) (Barangay Hall, City Prosecutor Office)
Birth certificate of minor dependents (LCR)
Income Tax Return or Barangay Certification of Indigency (Barangay Hall, BIR)
1 piece 1x1 & 1 piece 2x2 ID picture
Home Visit for validation
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Family and Community Welfare Section

services.name: Financial Assistance for VAWC Clients
services.summary: Counselling, help filing a case and cash aid for women and children who suffered violence.
requirements: Medico legal Report (Hospital)
Barangay Certification of Residency (Barangay Hall)
Barangay Protection Order (BPO) (Barangay Hall)
PNP Blotter Report (PNP Station)
services.where: Office on Social Welfare and Development Services – Family and Community Welfare Section

services.name: Livelihood Assistance for Indigent Family
services.summary: Livelihood help for poor families after a home visit and assessment.
requirements: Barangay Certification of Residency (Barangay Hall)
Barangay Certification of Indigency (Barangay Hall)
